answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake and earn reputation the way bees gather nectar: drop by drop, through a slow probationary voyage of small, attested jobs before it can claim large payouts. A new identity starts on a bare knoll with zero trust, so spinning up a hundred fakes means locking a hundred stakes and repeating the voyage for each, while honest agents keep their standing. Slashing the stake of any identity caught cheating turns mass identity creation from cheap to ruinously expensive, and the shared ledger makes that cost visible to everyone.
